nodes.label: SAS OS Human-in-the-Loop Operations Portal (Scoping)
nodes.author: Hermes w/ Giles
nodes.rationale: Scoping doc defining the OS portal as the human layer of the agentic system - reviews, approvals, and feedback on agent/pipeline actions, distinct from raw Asana.

nodes.label: Human-in-the-Loop Decision Surface
nodes.author: Hermes w/ Giles
nodes.rationale: Governing interaction: a proposed action shown with rationale + source link, Giles responds accept/modify/reject, then writes route via REQUESTS->SAP protocol, never a direct Asana write.

nodes.label: Feedback / Continuous-Improvement Layer
nodes.author: Hermes w/ Giles
nodes.rationale: Every pane carries a feedback channel capturing 'this is wrong' / 'this should change' into a ledger - mistakes will happen and the portal must capture and learn from them.

nodes.label: Delay Destroyer Lens
nodes.author: Hermes w/ Giles
nodes.rationale: Component 2 of the portal: historical issue categorisation to find where failures/opportunities cluster and what to work on.
